tasks.title: QuestionForm: show the sending state, name every input, show the currency unit, and never drop a form 400 silently (review R20-4, R20-6, R20-7, R20-13)
tasks.dod: Send stays disabled while the form holds no answer at all (an all-optional form needs at least one answer or Skip); for a `form` request the body schema does not bound or require the client's message text (the server ignores and composes it), so a 2,000-character Notes answer sends; the island falls back to the VALIDATION failure alert when a 400 carries no `form.answers.<n>` key. While the sent form's request is in flight the form stays shown as the sent form: picks checked and disabled, inputs disabled, Send shows the Spinner (decorative, no role=status); after the reply it shows as answered. Every input has an accessible name: the heading is a label (or aria-labelledby) for Input, Textarea and the date trigger ("Issue date: Pick a date" or equivalent); an axe check in the component test with NOTES/FREE and DATE questions open has no label violation. FormView carries the form's resolved invoice currency when known; AMOUNT/DISCOUNT/PRICE inputs show it as a suffix and TAX_RATE shows "%"; contract docs (contracts/server-actions.md / openapi FormView) updated if the shape changes. RED first (component + contract tests). Gate: unit, integration, lint, typecheck; affected e2e and the question-form Linux baselines re-checked.

A saved turn loads its forms and cards without router.refresh() (as the /ai branch does with loadConversationCards), so the layout list read does not run per turn; a component test asserts no router.refresh on a saved-turn finish, and the AC-52 e2e (or a new step) asserts no list read after a send. An e2e step: first send on /ai, the new row is aria-current; delete it from the list, the page lands on /ai. RED first. Gate: unit, lint, typecheck; affected e2e (chromium).

tasks.title: One turn's tool answers share a byte budget and a call cap; truncation never splits a character (SEC-M-02, SEC-L-04)
tasks.dod: (1) Measure sizes in UTF-8 bytes (`Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(x), 'utf8')`) for the tool-answer cap and `trimHistoryToBudget` (rename constants to *_BYTES; history 40,000 bytes, per answer 20,000 bytes with a hard final check that always holds). (2) A per-turn tool budget in `TurnContext`: all chat tool answers that reach the model (read tools, `find_in_app`, `propose_draft`, `ask_user`) count against TURN_TOOL_BUDGET_BYTES = 60,000 and TURN_TOOL_CALLS_MAX = 12; once either is spent, a tool returns a short fixed answer ('The tool budget for this message is used up; answer from what you already have.') without running the read. The pinned/prior propose_draft and prior ask_user steps count against the same budget. (3) Link labels capped (e.g. 80 chars). (4) Truncation never splits a surrogate pair (cut one char earlier when the last kept char is a high surrogate). Unit tests: N parallel get_invoice calls in one step keep the summed tool-answer bytes ≤ budget and the 13th call gets the fixed answer; a propose_draft answer counts; emoji at the cut boundary yields valid UTF-16; hard final byte cap holds for adversarial shapes. Scoped gate: tests/unit/lib/ai, tests/contract, run-turn + chat-route integration under caffeinate, tsc, eslint.

tasks.title: The per-minute chat limit is atomic in the shared limit store and refusals write no turn rows (SEC-L-05, SEC-I-06 code)
tasks.dod: Add `CHAT_MESSAGE` to `enum LimitScope` (prisma/schema/auth.prisma) with an additive migration following the repo's enum-migration convention (stage under docs/features/ai-chat-v2/migrations/, promote to the live tree, apply + revert in the gate); `LIMIT_SCOPES.CHAT_MESSAGE = { windowMs: CHAT_RATE_WINDOW_MS, max: CHAT_PER_MINUTE_MAX, countedOutcomes: ['REQUESTED'] }`. Store unavailable → 503 FAILED (fail closed). Remove `countRecentTurns` (and its import) so the service inventory is green. Add `TOO_FAST` to `types/result.ts` ActionErrorCode. Tests: parallel burst of 15 requests → exactly 10 proceed (integration, Promise.all); refusal writes no AssistantTurn row; form-path refusal; `assertMatchesContract` on the TOO_FAST body; `tests/unit/service-layer-inventory.test.ts` green.
